$comment: Claude Code verification runs (Change 06 S.7). `fixture` is relative to the clikgate_sdks root; `<cli>/` is the setup command's folder (clikgate_mobile_sdk/cli, or CLIKGATE_CLI_DIR). unattended: (This is an unattended run: nobody can open a browser or answer questions, so don't wait for an answer. I approve in advance the changes you show me: show them, then apply them.)
appPrompt: Set up Clikgate in this project using the Clikgate setup skill (or https://clikgate.com/docs/ai/setup.md). My Clikgate app is "{app}" ({ids}). scenarios.prompt: Add Clikgate to this Express backend using the Clikgate setup skill. Visitors land on `/` from Clikgate links; they apply with POST /applications; a loan officer approves days later with POST /applications/:id/approve. When an application is approved, send the goal `loan_approved` with the approved amount in NGN. The test API key will be in the CLIKGATE_API_KEY environment variable. Show me every change before making it, then run `npm run typecheck`.
